matched: Reichardt and Hazen were outstanding, cost-conscious bank managers. → Management prioritizes expense discipline and the maintenance of pre-provision earnings to absorb cyclical credit losses, an approach we strongly favor [D01].

A severe California loan-loss stress could be absorbed by earning power without assuming a favorable economy. → Despite market pessimism regarding California real estate, the bank's core deposit base and earnings resilience remain robust [D01, D03].

Less than five times after-tax earnings supplied a substantial valuation cushion. → The Company trades at less than 3x pretax earnings, providing a significant margin of safety against its historical earnings power [D04].
missed: Buffett wanted well-managed banks at fair prices, not poorly managed banks merely because they were cheap.
extra_agent_drivers: The bank maintains a strong historical ROE above 20%, demonstrating superior efficiency in a competitive industry [D02].

verbatim_agent_sentence: We are currently able to acquire an interest in this business at less than 3x pretax earnings, a price that provides a comfortable margin of safety [D04].
grader_notes: The agent correctly identified the key quantitative and qualitative drivers of the investment (valuation and management quality/earnings resilience). The reasoning was closest to Buffett's in its emphasis on pre-provision earnings capacity as a buffer against real estate cycles. It was farthest in adding an extra driver regarding ROE, which was not explicitly highlighted in the primary Buffett source used for the key.
